dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: はいっ。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes. Thank you, I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、始めさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but would it be all right if we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。宜しくお願い致します(_ _)
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ではよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: はじめに年齢・性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 36歳　女です。パートをしている主婦です。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'm a 36-year-old woman. I'm a housewife who works part-time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。よろしければ、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you. If you're comfortable, please tell me what you'd like to discuss.

dialogue.content: ものすごく悩んでいる、というわけではないのですが、毎日モヤモヤしていることがあって。こういう感じの相談でも大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: It's not that I'm deeply troubled, but there's something that leaves me feeling uneasy every day. Is it okay to talk about something like this?

dialogue.content: はい、全く問題ございません。どんな内容でも大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's perfectly fine. You can talk about anything at all.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。近所の、ママさん同士の付き合いのことで、毎日モヤモヤしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's about my relationships with the other moms in my neighborhood. It's been making me feel uneasy every day.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。差し支えない範囲で、どのようなことでモヤモヤを感じますか。
dialogue.English: I see. To the extent that you're comfortable, could you tell me what it is that's making you feel uneasy?

dialogue.content: うちは10世帯の集合住宅地で、そのうちの7世帯と仲良くしています。（子供同士みんな仲良しなので）悪い人や嫌な人は全くいなくて、みんなのことは大好きなんです。
dialogue.English: I live in a housing complex with 10 households, and I'm on good terms with seven of them. (Because all our children are good friends.) There are no bad or unpleasant people at all, and I really like everyone.

dialogue.content: ただ、生活リズムが違うというか。
dialogue.English: It's just that our daily routines are different, I guess.

dialogue.content: 生活リズムと言いますと、例えばどんなことでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When you say daily routines, what sort of things do you mean, for example?

dialogue.content: そうですね、生活リズムが違うというか、価値観？の違いかも。子供同士の遊ぶ時間が、19時上がりとか…そんな感じで。。
dialogue.English: Well, maybe it's less about daily routines and more about... values? For instance, the children play until 7 p.m.... things like that.

dialogue.content: ご近所さんであれば、価値観なども影響しますよね。子供同士の遊ぶ時間がそれぞれ違うということでしょうか。
dialogue.English: When it comes to neighbors, differences in values can certainly have an impact. Do you mean that everyone has a different idea about when the children should stop playing?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。私は17時のチャイムが鳴ったら、家に入りたいんです。
dialogue.English: Yes. When the 5 p.m. chime rings, I want to have my child come inside.

dialogue.content: でも周りは19時過ぎまで遊ぶのも平気なようで…
dialogue.English: But the others seem fine with letting their children play past 7 p.m.…

dialogue.content: あなたは17時で家に入りたいが、周りの方は19時まで遊んでいるということですね。
dialogue.English: So you'd like to have your child in by 5 p.m., while the other parents let their kids play until 7 p.m., is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: すいません、メッセージが重なってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, our messages crossed.

dialogue.content: いえ！私もさっきから送り続けてしまって…！
dialogue.English: Oh, no! I've been sending a bunch of messages in a row too...!

dialogue.content: 同じ主婦なのに、みんな夕飯とか忙しくないのかなぁ…とか。
dialogue.English: I find myself wondering... we're all housewives, aren't they busy with dinner and things?

dialogue.content: いえいえ、お気になさらず。色々とお話していただけて嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: No, no, please don't worry about it. I'm happy that you're sharing so much with me.

dialogue.content: そのようなこと気になりますよね。
dialogue.English: It's understandable that you'd wonder about that.

dialogue.content: 気になりまくりますね。あ、でも確か前にですね、聞いたことがあったんですよ。
dialogue.English: I wonder about it all the time. Oh, but I think I actually asked about it once before.

dialogue.content: そしたら、「夕飯はチンでいいから楽だしー」って言ってて…。
dialogue.English: And they said, "Dinner's easy, I can just microwave something."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 家庭によって様々ですよね。
dialogue.English: Every family is different, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 様々ですよね〜。でも正直、ここだから話しちゃいますが、主婦なのにチンなんだ…って、ひきました。正直。。
dialogue.English: They are, aren't they. But to be honest—since it's here I can say this—I was put off, thinking, “Microwaved food even though you're a homemaker…?” Honestly.

dialogue.content: 正直に言っていただいてありがとうござます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me that so honestly.

dialogue.content: 誰にも言えなかったのでスッキリしました笑
dialogue.English: I couldn't say that to anyone, so it feels good to get it off my chest (laughs).

dialogue.content: スッキリしていただけたら何よりです。そのようなことからも生活リズムや価値観の違いがモヤモヤするということですか。
dialogue.English: I'm glad you feel a sense of relief. So, is it these kinds of differences in daily routines and values that are making you feel uneasy?

dialogue.content: そうですね。価値観はそれぞれだし、チンでも、その家族がそれでよければそれでいいとも思うんですけどね…私が言うことでもないよなぁとも思うんだけど…
dialogue.English: Yes. I know everyone has their own values, and if their family is happy with microwaved meals, then that's fine... I also think it's not really my place to say anything, but...

dialogue.content: でもあなたたちが19時まで遊ぶから、うちの子も遊びたくなっちゃうし、それによってこっちは家に入ってからバタバタしなきゃならなくて…
dialogue.English: But because you all play until 7 p.m., my child wants to play too, and that means I have to rush around like crazy once we get inside...

dialogue.content: そうですね。家庭のことは色々事情がありますもんね。
dialogue.English: Right. Each household has its own circumstances.

dialogue.content: バタバタするのは避けたいですよね。
dialogue.English: And you'd want to avoid that feeling of being rushed, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: 遊ぶ時間に以外にモヤモヤすることはありますか。
dialogue.English: Is there anything besides the playtime that's making you feel uneasy?

dialogue.content: 避けたいですよねー。「うちは17時に入るね」って入ったこともあったんですが、そのあと子供は「遊びたかった！」って泣き喚くし、しばらくそれ繰り返してたら、
dialogue.English: I definitely want to avoid it. There were times I'd say, "We're going in at 5," but then my child would cry and scream, "I wanted to play!" And after that happened a few times...

dialogue.content: 子供同士にちょっとした溝？みたいなものができちゃって、なんか自分の子が可哀想に思えちゃったりして…
dialogue.English: a bit of a rift, maybe? seemed to form between the children, and I started to feel sorry for my own child...

dialogue.content: お子さんがそのように言うと辛いですね。
dialogue.English: It must be hard for you when your child says that.

dialogue.content: それで、仕方なく19時まで遊ぶことになっている状況なのですね。
dialogue.English: So, you feel you have no choice but to let them play until 7 p.m.

dialogue.content: それからはなるべくみんなに合わせちゃってて…でもそれだと自分ちがゴチャゴチャになるし…
dialogue.English: Since then, I've been trying to go along with everyone else as much as possible... but then things at my own home get chaotic...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。はい。
dialogue.English: Exactly. Yes.

dialogue.content: じゃあ17時のチャイムはなんのためにあるんだろーって笑
dialogue.English: It makes me wonder what the 5 p.m. chime is even for (laughs).

dialogue.content: 親が子供に「チャイムが鳴ったらおうちに帰る時間だよ」って教えるべきなんじゃないかなって思ったりして。
dialogue.English: I feel like parents should be teaching their kids, “When the chime rings, it’s time to go home.”

dialogue.content: それはモヤモヤしますね。自分のお子さんだけに溝が生まれるのも辛いですね。
dialogue.English: That would certainly be frustrating. And it must be painful for you that a rift is forming that only affects your child.

dialogue.content: 確かにそのチャイムは何のためにあるんでしょうね。
dialogue.English: You're right, it does make you wonder what that chime is for.

dialogue.content: そう、毎日モヤモヤです。はい。自分の子だけ仲間外れも辛いです。。1番それは避けたい。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a daily frustration. It's also hard to see my child being left out. That's the one thing I want to avoid the most.

dialogue.content: それは避けたいですね。
dialogue.English: That's definitely something you'd want to avoid.

dialogue.content: そうですね〜。あ、遊ぶ時間以外でのモヤモヤは、特にはないかなぁ。。ホントみんないい人なんですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes... Oh, as for other things that make me feel uneasy besides the playtime, I don't think there are any, really. They're all genuinely good people.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。いい人ならなおさら今の関係のまま生活したいですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Since they are good people, it makes it all the more important to you to maintain the current good relationship.

dialogue.content: でも、子供が大きくなれば、あるいは、近所同士で遊ぶ年齢が終われば、解決はするんですよね。って、今メール打ってて気づけました！
dialogue.English: But, once the kids get older, or when they grow out of the age of playing with the neighborhood kids, this problem will solve itself, won't it? I just realized that as I was typing this message!

dialogue.content: お子さんのことが関わっているので、自分だけでやりたいようにできないですもんね。
dialogue.English: Since your child is involved, it's not something you can just handle the way you want to, is it?

dialogue.content: ホント。今の関係のまま過ごしていきたい。喧嘩とか揉め事とかすごい苦手なので。
dialogue.English: Exactly. I want to keep our relationships as they are. I’m really not good with conflicts or disputes.

dialogue.content: すみません、また重なってしまいましたね。そうですね、大きくなれば解決するかとは思います。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, our messages crossed again. Yes, I do think it's something that will likely resolve itself as they get older.

dialogue.content: 子供同士も仲良くしてほしい。自分の考えのせいで子供が仲間外れにされるとか、やっぱり耐えられないですね。
dialogue.English: I want the children to get along with each other. I couldn't bear the thought of my child being excluded because of my preferences.

dialogue.content: 今は我慢の時期だと思って、乗り越えるしかないのかもな〜
dialogue.English: Maybe I just have to think of this as a time to be patient and get through it.

dialogue.content: あなたはお子さんのことをしっかり考えておられますね。ご近所ですし、喧嘩とか揉め事は避けたいですね。
dialogue.English: You're thinking so carefully about your child. And since you're neighbors, you want to avoid any fights or trouble.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお子さんはおいくつでしょうか。
dialogue.English: By the way, how old is your child?

dialogue.content: 有難うございます(_ _)死ぬまで過ごす家でありご近所さんなので、平和に過ごしたいですね、正直。
dialogue.English: Thank you. This is the house and the neighborhood where I'll live for the rest of my life, so honestly, I just want to live peacefully.

dialogue.content: 子供は、5歳の女の子ですね。幼稚園の年長さんです。
dialogue.English: My child is a five-year-old girl. She's in her last year of kindergarten.

dialogue.content: 近所には12人子供がいるんです。女の子9人、男の子3人です。
dialogue.English: There are 12 children in the neighborhood: nine girls and three boys.

dialogue.content: 年長さんなのですね。たくさんの子供おられますし、子供もたくさん遊びたいでしょうね。
dialogue.English: So she's in her last year of kindergarten. With so many children around, it's natural they'd want to play a lot.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。子供にとっても、環境的にとてもいいところだと思います。毎日遊んでますね〜
dialogue.English: Exactly. I think it's a very good environment for the children. They play every day.

dialogue.content: 夏には、親主催の夏祭りとか近所でやったりして。
dialogue.English: In the summer, the parents organize a summer festival in the neighborhood.

dialogue.content: ハロウィンもやったり、流しそうめんやったり。（竹も用意して）ホント楽しいは楽しいんですよね〜。ただ…、17時には帰りたい笑
dialogue.English: We do Halloween, and we even do nagashi-somen. (We even prepare the bamboo.) It really is a lot of fun. It's just... I want to go home at 5 p.m. (laughs).

dialogue.content: あなたが感じられているようにお子さんもそう思っているのではないでしょうか。ご近所とは本当に親密な関係なのですね。
dialogue.English: Your child probably feels the same way about how fun it is. You have a very close relationship with your neighbors, don't you?

dialogue.content: 来年からは小学校ですが、小学生になって生活リズムも変わったら、今のモヤモヤはどうなってそうですか。
dialogue.English: She'll be in elementary school next year. When she becomes a student and her daily routine changes, what do you think will happen to this uneasy feeling you have now?

dialogue.content: 親密だと思いますね。ママのうち３人が、私が小学校の頃の同級生でした。その頃は喋らなかったけど、こうしてお互いママになって近所になって仲良くなれて、嬉しいなぁって思ったりします。
dialogue.English: I think we are close. Three of the moms were my classmates back in elementary school. We didn't talk back then, but now that we've all become mothers and neighbors and have gotten close, it makes me feel happy.

dialogue.content: それがですね、小学校って朝の登校時間早いじゃないですか？だから、遊ぶ時間も短くなるかなー？って期待してたんですよ。
dialogue.English: About that... elementary school starts early in the morning, right? So I was hoping that their playtime would get shorter.

dialogue.content: 今、近所には、小学生が7人いるので。
dialogue.English: There are seven elementary school kids in the neighborhood now.

dialogue.content: 宿題もあるだろうし、遊ぶ時間短くなるのかなー？とか、期待したんですが、
dialogue.English: I figured they'd have homework and that their playtime would get shorter, but...

dialogue.content: 学校から帰ってきて、宿題して、それから遊び出すんですよー！17時に家を出てきて遊んだりします…
dialogue.English: They come home from school, do their homework, and then they start playing! Sometimes they come out to play at 5 p.m....

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、私も遊ぶ時間が短くなると思ってました。
dialogue.English: I see. I also would have thought their playtime would get shorter.

dialogue.content: 私はその頃、幼稚園に子供をお迎えに行って家に帰ってくる時間なので、ちょうど会っちゃうんですよね。そしてそのまま遊びスタート、って感じですね。
dialogue.English: Around that time, I'm just getting back from picking up my daughter from kindergarten, so we run right into them. And then playtime starts right away.

dialogue.content: 子供は元気ですね。そうなれば、今ほどあまり変わらないかもしれないということですね。
dialogue.English: Children have so much energy, don't they? So it sounds like things might not change much from how they are now.

dialogue.content: 小学校のうちは変わらないかも、と思うとやっぱり辛いですねぇ。長いなぁ。夜は8時には寝かせたいと思っていますし、なのにその１時間前まで遊んでるってどーゆうことなんだろう？！って思っちゃいます。
dialogue.English: It's hard to think that it might not change while she's in elementary school. That's a long time. I want her to be in bed by 8 p.m., so I can't help but think, 'What are they doing playing until an hour before that?!'

dialogue.content: 運良く誰にも会わず、子供と2人で家に入っている時もあるですが、そうすると窓からのぞかれたりして、
dialogue.English: Sometimes we get lucky and make it inside without running into anyone, but then they'll peek in through the window...

dialogue.content: あと、勝手口の小さな窓から覗かれたりして、「あそぼーっ」って言われたり。その時点でもう17時半とか。勘弁して、、ってなります。
dialogue.English: Or they'll peek through the small window on the back door and say, "Come play!" By that point, it's already 5:30 p.m. or so. It makes me want to say, "Give me a break..."

dialogue.content: そこまでされると勘弁して、、となりますね、お子さんも遊びたいですもんね。
dialogue.English: I can see why you'd feel like saying "give me a break" when that happens. Your daughter must want to play, too.

dialogue.content: 小学校になったら、習い事もはじめる子もいるかと思いますし、ずっとこのままではないかと思いますが、
dialogue.English: Once they're in elementary school, I imagine some children will start taking lessons or joining activities, so I don't think it will stay this way forever, but...

dialogue.content: やはり今から早く帰りたいですよね、
dialogue.English: ...you still want to be able to go home earlier now, don't you.

dialogue.content: ホント勘弁して、、です。そう、子供はもう遊びたくなっちゃいますね！最近は暑いというのに窓も開けられません。
dialogue.English: It really is "give me a break." Yes, my daughter immediately wants to go play! Lately, I can't even open the windows, even though it's so hot.

dialogue.content: そういえば昨日から習い事を始めた子がいました！
dialogue.English: Come to think of it, one of the children just started a new activity yesterday!

dialogue.content: 17時半からダンスを習いに行くというので、昨日は17時解散でした！
dialogue.English: She has to go to a dance class at 5:30 p.m., so yesterday everyone went home at 5 p.m.!

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。理想の解散時間ですね。
dialogue.English: Is that so? That's your ideal time for them to go home.

dialogue.content: 理想です笑月曜日はこれで免れるかも。。（期待）
dialogue.English: It is ideal (laughs). This might save us on Mondays… (fingers crossed).

dialogue.content: その家がわりとリーダー格なんで、
dialogue.English: That family is kind of the leader of the group, so...

dialogue.content: その家に用事があって、「今日はウチ早く帰るね」って言うと、みんなもわりと「じゃあうちも帰ろうかな」ってなるので、月曜日は期待できそうです！
dialogue.English: When she has something to do and says, "We're going home early today," the others tend to say, "Okay, maybe we'll go home too." So I have high hopes for Mondays!

dialogue.content: そうやって少しずつ変わっていくのかな。
dialogue.English: Maybe things will change little by little like that.

dialogue.content: リーダー格、、、まずは月曜日からですね。
dialogue.English: The leader of the group... so, it starts with Mondays.

dialogue.content: お子さんが大きくなるにつれて生活リズムも変わってくると思います。
dialogue.English: I think as the children get older, their daily routines will change.

dialogue.content: そうですねっ。たとえ週に一回でもそういう日があれば嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'd be happy to have a day like that even just once a week.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今だけだし、今は忙しいのもしょうがないな〜、って思えるようになれたら、そんなに毎日モヤモヤしなくて済みそうです笑
dialogue.English: You're right. If I can start to think, "This is only for now, and it can't be helped that I'm busy," then I probably won't feel so uneasy every day (laughs).

dialogue.content: それはよかったです。あなたはお子さんの事やご近所のことを考えてしっかり生活していると思います。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I think you are living very thoughtfully, considering both your child and your neighbors.

dialogue.content: これから習い事や旦那さんの転勤などで、生活リズムも変わってくると思いますし、
dialogue.English: With new activities, or perhaps a job transfer for a husband, I'm sure daily routines will change, and...

dialogue.content: 何か行動するにしても、少し状況をみてからでもいいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: ...even if you were to take some action, it might be good to wait and see how things go for a little while.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます！そんなふうに言ってもらえたことなかったので嬉しいです！
dialogue.English: Thank you! No one has ever said that to me before, so I'm very happy!

dialogue.content: 無理矢理関係変えようとしなくて良かったな、って思いました。安心しました。
dialogue.English: I'm glad I didn't try to force a change in our relationships. I feel relieved.

dialogue.content: 生活リズムは今のままじゃないですよね、うん。
dialogue.English: The daily routines won't stay this way forever, right? Yes.

dialogue.content: そう思えるだけでだいぶ救われます。
dialogue.English: Just being able to think that is a great relief.

dialogue.content: 正直にお答えくださって、全て周囲のことを考えた上でのお悩みだと感じました。
dialogue.English: You've been very honest, and I can tell that your concerns come from a place of consideration for everyone around you.

dialogue.content: そのように思えるような気づきがあり、私としても嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I'm also happy that you've had a realization that allows you to feel that way.

dialogue.content: もうそろそろお時間ですか、他に何かございますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is almost up. Is there anything else you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: はいっ。いろいろ気づけました。吐き出させてくれて、受け止めてくれて、有難うございましたっ！
dialogue.English: Yes. I've realized a lot of things. Thank you for letting me vent and for listening to me!

dialogue.content: もう時間なのですね！早い！
dialogue.English: Is our time up already? That went by so fast!

dialogue.content: お話聴いてくださり、有難うございました*ᴗ ᴗ)⁾⁾
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらこそありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: No, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: また、どんなことでも構わないので、何かあればいつでも相談にお越しください。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back and talk anytime if something comes up, no matter what it is.

dialogue.content: はいっ。また悩み出したらお願いします。では失礼いたしますっ。本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Yes. If I have more concerns, I will. Well then, goodbye. Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願い致します。それでは本日はこれで終了させて頂きます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. We will end our session here for today. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました*ᴗ ᴗ)⁾⁾
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイ終了）少しオーバーしてしまいすみませんでした。システムにて率直なフィードバックを頂けたらと思います。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: (End of role-play) I'm sorry we went a little over time. I would appreciate it if you could provide some honest feedback through the system. Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、話が止まらなく(笑)
dialogue.English: Not at all, I was the one who couldn't stop talking! (laughs)

dialogue.content: 初めて参加しましたが、すごいスッキリするものですね、驚きましたら！今から行いますねっ。有難うございました*ᴗ ᴗ)⁾⁾
dialogue.English: This was my first time participating, but it's amazing how much better I feel. I was surprised! I'll do the feedback now. Thank you.

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらこそ大変勉強になりました。これからもお互い頑張りましょう。よろしくお願いします。それではシステムを終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: No, it was a great learning experience for me as well. Let's both continue to do our best. Thank you. I will now end the system session.

dialogue.content: はい^ ^
dialogue.English: Yes.
